Например

title: Great idea, plenty of room to develop, still worth to download
body:
I'd say app lacks more professional 2019 design. It's quite user friendly, but there is still place to be better. I think that pixel interface could be used also in the background, because blank white looks raw. 

Technical issues like delay in registration of action on iPhone se. 

I'd recommend to add possibly of offline action registration, while it's sometimes annoying that app is unable to recognise this or that action with no internet access. 

What would be another great killing feature is to add in tavern challenges and quests of community (with something more exciting than quitting smoking) for people who don't know how to use app.
